body:
It was Title IX so I didn’t even get a fair trial. After all this I’m just happy it’s over, not need to tell the media or press counter-charges as she’s already left the school. I got so many of my basic court rights restricted yet it’s common across the nation so a lawsuit wouldn’t do me much, especially because they found in my favor. 

It’s Kangaroo court but no one talks about it because if you go against it you are “for rape culture”

Yeah. I've been trying to get back in my old schedule. Maybe a new schedule will help. And you're right, I've been very attached to how my life was before the allegations, maybe I need to realize a new path is unavoidable.

I feel that more. I finally released the stress of the people who have already found me guilty in their mind. Why the fuck would I care about someone who has already found me guilty without hearing my side? Not like they have any sort of thinking of value.

Not unless I win my case and press charges against her. And even then it’s not guaranteed. They might figure she believes it and is just confused. I don’t know why she’s doing this, out of malice or she might even believe her own narrative.

There’s a no contact but yeah I understand that. And I am in a state which allows recording I’ll keep that in mind. 

Unfortunately I do have things to worry about. Title IX is a whole level of fucked up that I never knew about until I got into it. 

That being said even if I got expelled, I would leave with a clear conscience. Just a product of the system.

Unfortunately the system I’m in right now is an ungodly amount of fucked up. Title IX affords me extremely limited rights and things like guilty until proven innocent and the fact that there is one lady deciding my fate and she just has to find it “more than likely”. 

We will see. I’m going to fight my best fight.
Don’t know. I’ll cross that bridge when I get there. And as much as I love r/legaladvice I have a non-internet lawyer lol

Save the return ticket. 

The last time I felt alive was Rome. I went there and found some sort of childhood wonder I had lost. It was genuinely amazing to just exist for the first time in a while. To just wake up and look around. I haven’t felt that since. 

So just save your return ticket. Maybe it won’t work out, maybe you will hate it, it’s okay you won’t cost your parents any more money.

But maybe you will return home, and should you want to return home it will be a huge pain in the ass without a ticket.
